page.overview:
Who is Abin Sur?

In the Earth year of 1953, he was alerted to a massive energy surge coming from a planet in the Delta Vega system. Upon his investigation, he found Superman trapped on the planet along with its residents who were oppressed by the Grobex.

After liberating the Delta Vega residents from their oppressors, Abin Sur helped Superman return to his home planet, where Abin discovered a human named Alan Scott, who had forged a ring from a Green Lantern's metal to become Earth's Green Lantern.
